payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is at least one frog clearly placed within the toilet bowl, rather than merely overlapping the rim or resting on the lid or nearby?
node.criteria: complete: at least one frog is clearly situated within the bowl's interior, with its placement distinguishable from merely resting on or overlapping the rim. partial: a frog has been added to the toilet area but is only partly over the bowl, overlaps the rim without clear interior placement, or is on the lid. absent: no frog has been added to the toilet area. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine placement. Ignore additional frogs when assessing fulfillment.
node.binding: The toilet bowl interior and any added frog, grounded in the image.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"A frog is clearly situated inside the toilet bowl, within the rim. Other frogs are on the lid and floor, but do not affect this check.","confidence":0.99}
